title: HAServe: Horizon-Aware Scheduling and Memory Co-Design for Efficient LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2605.08581v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online large language model (LLM) services process requests that share context but differ in prefix structure and arrival timing. Finite capacity couples request admission and key-value (KV) retention. This paper addresses one online serving problem: using a unified view of visible demand to choose the feasible joint admission and KV-retention candidate with the lowest predicted latency cost as prefix structures and arrival rates vary. To model this problem, we introduce HorizonSchema, a workload abstraction that connects exact prefix paths, permitted serializations, and released consumers as shared inputs to both decisions. Our analysis shows that useful reuse depends on demand and prefix survival, while service order changes latency even at equal computation. Furthermore, we present HAServe, which turns this abstraction into a scheduling--memory co-design method of systematic optimization for online LLM serving. We implement HAServ

translated_title: HAServe：面向高效大语言模型服务的视界感知调度与内存协同设计
translated_abstract: 在线大语言模型（LLM）服务处理的请求共享上下文，但前缀结构和到达时机各不相同。有限的容量将请求准入与键值（KV）缓存保留耦合在一起。本文针对一个在线服务问题：随着前缀结构和到达率的变化，利用对可见需求的统一视图，选择预测延迟成本最低的、可行的请求准入与KV保留联合方案。为了对该问题建模，我们提出了HorizonSchema，这是一种工作负载抽象，它将精确的前缀路径、允许的序列化方式以及已释放的消费者连接起来，作为两项决策的共享输入。我们的分析表明，有效的复用取决于需求与前缀存活情况，而在计算量相同的情况下，服务顺序也会改变延迟。此外，我们提出了HAServe，它将该抽象转化为一种面向在线LLM服务的、系统化优化的调度—内存协同设计方法。我们实现了HAServ（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HAServe，一种面向在线LLM服务的调度与内存协同设计方法，通过统一需求视图联合优化请求准入与KV缓存保留，以最小化预测延迟成本。
en_tdlr: HAServe is a scheduling-memory co-design method for online LLM serving that jointly optimizes request admission and KV-cache retention through a unified view of visible demand to minimize predicted latency cost.
